acl_subnets.description: Lua table string containing the allowed source IP subnets for ACL.

control_bind_address.description: IP address for the dnsdist console control socket.

control_port.description: Port for the dnsdist console control socket.

control_key.default: please generate a fresh private key with makeKey()
control_key.description: Secret key string for console authentication.

webserver_bind_address.description: IP address for the dnsdist web server interface.

webserver_port.description: Port for the dnsdist web server interface.

webserver_password.description: Password for the dnsdist web server interface.

carbon_server_ip.description: IP address for the Carbon/Metronome statistics server.

carbon_server_unique_name.description: Unique name identifier sent to the Carbon server.

do53_bind_address.description: IP address to bind for plain DNS (Do53) queries.

dnscrypt_bind_address.description: IP address to bind for DNSCrypt queries.

dnscrypt_cert_file.description: Path to the DNSCrypt public certificate file.

dnscrypt_key_file.description: Path to the DNSCrypt private key file.

dot_bind_address.description: IP address to bind for DNS over TLS (DoT) queries.

dot_port.description: Port for DNS over TLS (DoT) queries.

dot_cert_files.description: Lua table string containing paths to TLS certificate files.

dot_key_files.description: Lua table string containing paths to TLS private key files.

dot_provider_options.description: Lua table string containing TLS provider configuration options.

doh_bind_address.description: IP address to bind for DNS over HTTPS (DoH) queries.

doh_port.description: Port for DNS over HTTPS (DoH) queries.

doh_cert_files.description: Lua table string containing paths to TLS certificate files for DoH.

doh_key_files.description: Lua table string containing paths to TLS private key files for DoH.

backend_1_address.description: IP address of the first backend DNS server.

backend_2_address.description: IP address of the second backend DNS server.

backend_2_port.description: Port for the second backend DNS server.

backend_2_pool.description: Pool name for the second backend server.

ring_buffers_size.description: Size of the in-memory ring buffers for live-traffic inspection.

ring_buffer_shards.description: Number of shards for the ring buffers.

max_tcp_client_threads.description: Maximum number of TCP client threads.

abuse_domains.description: Lua table string containing domain suffixes to route to the abuse pool.

abuse_pool_name.description: Name of the pool used for abuse handling.

abuse_subnet.description: Netmask/Prefix for clients to be routed to the abuse pool.

dynblock_query_rate_max.description: Max queries per window for dynamic blocking.

dynblock_query_rate_window.description: Window size in seconds for query rate dynamic blocking.

dynblock_query_rate_reason.description: Reason string for query rate dynamic block.

dynblock_query_rate_ttl.description: TTL in seconds for query rate dynamic block.

dynblock_nxdomain_rate_max.description: Max NXDOMAIN responses per window for dynamic blocking.

dynblock_nxdomain_rate_window.description: Window size in seconds for NXD rate dynamic blocking.

dynblock_nxdomain_rate_reason.description: Reason string for NXD rate dynamic block.

dynblock_nxdomain_rate_ttl.description: TTL in seconds for NXD rate dynamic block.

dynblock_servfail_rate_max.description: Max SERVFAIL responses per window for dynamic blocking.

dynblock_servfail_rate_window.description: Window size in seconds for ServFail rate dynamic blocking.

dynblock_servfail_rate_reason.description: Reason string for ServFail rate dynamic block.

dynblock_servfail_rate_ttl.description: TTL in seconds for ServFail rate dynamic block.

dynblock_any_rate_max.description: Max ANY queries per window for dynamic blocking.

dynblock_any_rate_window.description: Window size in seconds for ANY rate dynamic blocking.

dynblock_any_rate_reason.description: Reason string for ANY rate dynamic block.

dynblock_any_rate_ttl.description: TTL in seconds for ANY rate dynamic block.

dynblock_response_byte_rate_max.description: Max response bytes per window for dynamic blocking.

dynblock_response_byte_rate_window.description: Window size in seconds for response byte rate dynamic blocking.

dynblock_response_byte_rate_reason.description: Reason string for response byte rate dynamic block.

dynblock_response_byte_rate_ttl.description: TTL in seconds for response byte rate dynamic block.

remote_logger_address.description: Address (IP:Port) for the remote protobuf logger.

dnstap_tcp_logger_address.description: Address (IP:Port) for the remote DNSTAP TCP logger.

cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries in the packet cache.
